summary: Single Rovers and Blitzes took our naked outer spots from 2:31, the middle seat falling to 2 extractors at 4:00, while our three starved openings had 6-10 factory units by 4:00 against the pool's 17-19. From 4:00 to 13:00 our three seats' army was at least 4 times what we saw of his, and we held up to 29-31 extractors. But at 4:30 the player split it into two home pickets and a lone north raid, which stalled at C1 and lost 11 for 2 at 7:51. The first combined push, 64 Blitzes of two seats at 9:30, traded 7,040 for 4,825 into his D3/C3 nest of beamers, light turrets and Stouts, and his factory was never seen. The middle seat's ball of 44-53 Blitzes, the home guard by the player's word and beyond every later tool order because of the standing drain, held at H5 while one block of 8-10 Stouts and 4-7 Janus, seen at 11:30, killed the north seat (commander_t1 at 14:24). The ball then won every fight it joined (his 22 Stouts and 5 Janus lost 6,150 at G4, 15:10-16:09), but six Stouts took the south plant at 16:37, and Thunders (17:48) and Banshees (19:28) met no anti-air; the middle seat fell at 19:51 and the south at 21:21.

root.what: The player's (strategy, amplified by the harness): with 22 soldiers (2,104 metal) across the seats against 5 known extractors of his, the 4:30 packet split the army into three roles. group_A_t1 raided the north edge alone, and group_A_t2 and group_B_t3 picketed home; at 6:16 group_B_t3 'stays home at spot_48'. That dropped the player's own 3:20 plan of one combined ball west. The first window (4:00-5:00, 8-9x his seen army on the north seat alone) ended at 6:00 with no body in his half but the raid. The home ball grew to 46-53 Blitzes at H5/H6 (every minute 6:00-13:00) and was unused when the block crossed the north at 11:30-14:24. Every later order to move it (stations at 7:36, 8:10, 9:07, 9:53) was lost to the standing drain, and none appeared in its seat's log until 16:45.

lens.caveats: There is no truth file, results.jsonl or batch.json, so his numbers are floors of what we saw. His start is guessed (minutes.py says B5, pro_baseline mirrors to B8), so pro_baseline's pressure rows are empty. minutes, analyze_match, floor and raid_ledger read record-0 only, so the other seats were read through symlink views in scratchpad/r1790467496. impedance_sweep --seat did not switch records (identical for 0/1/2), so read it as the north seat. raid_ledger's 'answered 0' on every seat is likely the tool not matching tagged party names. floor differs from the review's run (unanswered 9/14/42 against 11/16/50, aband_m 0/160/128 against 0/26/25): the tool has changed. Dates follow the repository's convention (the batch stamp is 2026-09-27 00:04 UTC, 2026-09-26 20:04 EDT local). Where I differ from review.md: (1) it ranks the H5 hold first (decided by 14:00, cost-ranked), while cause before symptom puts the root at the 4:30 split; (2) its finding 5 makes the third seat's absence at 9:30 the player's, but the 9:07 transcript ordered group_B_t3 a southern prong (station spot_61) that the drain ate; (3) the ball's first move was the hands' 13:01 [plan] attack, when the block reached F3 (a spot in the 12:31 packet's trigger list); the 13:32 packet played at 13:43, not 13:33; and the ball was still at G3 (6,364, 1,828) at 14:23, not at G2 at about 14:20. Incident: my first symlink views in the shared scratchpad/seat1 and seat2 overwrote links of another reader (1790475913-bluegecko-3v1-comet-catcher-6) for about a minute around 00:17. I removed mine and pointed their strategist-0.jsonl and bot.log links at their match; that reader's per-seat runs at about 00:17 may have read this match.

open_questions: Did the packet's prose move group_B_t3 at 13:01? The 12:31 trigger list named spot_18 (F3), and the block reached F3 at about 12:57. Or was it the hands' own threat answer? The decompression review says no packet rule reached a tagged actor, yet the timing fits the prose.

His economy and start are unknown (no truth file). Was the game already lost on extractors before 11:30, as L-mex-game-over would say? A replay read (run/replay_match.py on the game's .sdfz, if one survives) could settle his extractor curve and his factory's place.
Was the north raid's 70 s stop at C1 (6:39-7:49) a light turret at spot_9 that the packet forbade attacking, or the old hands' fight_to failing to advance?
raid_ledger reads 'answered 0' on all three seats while floor gives react_s 2-3 s: is that the tool missing tagged party names, or were the raids truly unanswered?
